emptyProject: There are no drawing pages in this workspace.
emptyPanel: Open a project to inspect its engineering data.
guideText: Use View to show or hide panels. Each panel can be docked, resized or collapsed. Settings controls the theme, language and drawing background. Layout preferences are saved in this browser.
privacyText: Only interface preferences are saved by this workspace. Cloud services are not connected.
storageError: Preferences could not be saved in this browser.
invalidProject: The project is invalid. Existing work has been preserved.
saveError: Local saving failed. Keep this tab open and export your project.
corruptStorage: Saved project data could not be read. Existing storage has been preserved.
confirmReset: Reset saved projects? Export or back up your data first.
confirmReplace: A project with this ID exists. Replace it with the imported project?
editorHint: Click to place. Shift-click selects multiple symbols. Drag to move or select an area. Connect two pins in Wire mode. Arrow keys move selection; R rotates; Delete removes; Ctrl+Z/Y undoes/redoes.
connectivityScope: Topology and declared ratings only. Drawing length is not installed cable length.
ruleCORE_ON_MULTIPLE_NETS: Cable core assigned to disconnected nets
routePoints: Route points in mm (x, y per line; include both pin endpoints)
catalogScope: Source-backed catalog facts; symbol mapping is not manufacturer certification.
customSymbolScope: Create a box symbol with explicit electrical pins. No ratings or internal connections are inferred.
symbolPins: Pins: id, x, y per line (mm from center) [kind: power/control/signal/pe/neutral] [optional group after kind]
symbolArtwork: Artwork in mm: line, x1, y1, x2, y2 or circle, x, y, radius per line
originalSymbolsScope: Original generic symbols with explicit independent pins. No manufacturer ratings or standards certification. Import, then place from Custom symbols.
overload-relay-nc: Three-phase thermal overload with NC auxiliary
energy-meter-pulse: Single-phase energy meter with pulse interface
protection-relay-trip: Protection relay with measurement and trip interface
comparisonHint: Select two to four components. Missing values are not inferred.
propertyFiltersHint: Missing ratings are excluded when a rating filter is active.
catalogPreferencesCorrupt: Catalog preferences could not be read. Stored data has been preserved. Reset only catalog preferences to enable changes.
catalogPreferencesUnsaved: Catalog preferences are available in this session but could not be saved.
customComponentScope: User-supplied records remain unverified. Revisions preserve earlier records and assignments. Mapped symbol definitions are frozen; use a new definition for changed geometry.
componentDimensions: Mechanical dimensions (declare all three or leave blank)
componentSaved: Component revision created. Existing assignments are unchanged.
componentError: Component action rejected. Existing work has been preserved.
mechanicalSymbolHint: For mechanical parts, select mechanical and leave pins empty. Electrical symbols require connection points.
symbolLoadError: Engineering symbols could not load. Your project remains available for editing and export.
plc-cpu-serial: PLC CPU with discrete I/O and serial interface
counter-relay-reset: Counter relay with pulse and reset inputs
motor-single-phase-windings: Single-phase motor with separate run and start windings
starter-three-phase-trip: Three-phase starter assembly with trip contact
dc-motor-controller: DC motor controller with enable and direction interface
cable-four-core-shield: Four-core shielded signal cable with drain
catalogMissingData: Missing verified data — do not infer suitability
catalogMappingScope: Generic symbol mapping is an engineering interpretation, not manufacturer certification. Review date is not a manufacturer revision.
source-reviewed-facts: Listed facts reviewed against the manufacturer source; no physical certification.
factual-metadata-only: Factual metadata only. No manufacturer artwork, datasheets or CAD assets included; no redistribution rights granted.
buildingStructureScope: Building and floor structure with editable room boundaries in millimetres. Room edits retain their identity and floor assignment.
roomVerticesHelp: Use 3–256 distinct vertices in perimeter order. Crossing, touching or overlapping edges are rejected.
roomDrawingHelp: Click room corners in order. Finish saves the room; Escape cancels without changing the project.
roomMeasurementUnavailable: Measurements unavailable: repair the room boundary.
catalogLoadError: The component library could not load. Your project remains available for editing and export.
buildingLoadError: Building design could not load. Your project remains available in the schematic workspace.
svgPlanScope: Import line, polyline, polygon and plain rectangle coordinates. Set millimetres per SVG user unit explicitly: viewport width, height and viewBox do not set this scale. Group names become architectural layers. Unsupported geometry is reported; appearance is not imported. In automatic mode, absolute root width/height and viewBox determine the physical mapping.
svgAutomaticUnits: Use SVG viewport dimensions and physical units
dxfPlanScope: Import bounded ASCII DXF LINE and straight LWPOLYLINE model geometry. Declared units and layer visibility/locking are retained; Y is reversed for the plan. Other entities are reported, not approximated.
dxfTimeout: DXF parsing timed out; project unchanged.
planZoneScope: Zones group rooms on this floor. Selecting a zone highlights its rooms; board assignment does not create circuits.
planScaleScope: The screen fits the plan. SVG uses physical millimetre dimensions at the saved scale, including margins and visible geometry. Print at actual size; page fitting changes scale.
planEquipmentScope: Place an existing schematic device on a visible, unlocked electrical layer. Room assignment checks the anchor; symbol scale controls annotation size, not physical equipment dimensions. Moving the floor symbol does not move schematic wiring.
floorCircuitScope: Assign placed floor devices to distribution boards and circuits. Membership does not create pin-to-pin wiring or confirm code compliance.
boardAssignmentProtection: Remove circuit and zone assignments before removing this board association.
circuitRouteProtection: Unassign or remove the associated routes before removing this circuit.
circuitLoadEntryScope: Enter the active load for each selected device in watts. Blank means unknown; enter 0 only for a known zero load. Values are user supplied; demand and protective-device sizing are not calculated here.
deviceAssignedOtherCircuit: Already assigned to another floor circuit.
protectedCircuitLayers: Show and unlock the circuit, board and member-device layers to edit this circuit.
floorRouteScope: Routes store cable, conduit or tray geometry on this floor. Crossings do not connect wires. Lengths are horizontal plan lengths, excluding rises, drops, slack and installation allowances; overlapping routes are counted separately.
planRoutePoints: Route points (mm; one X,Y pair per line)
routePointsInvalid: Enter 2–10,000 finite X,Y pairs, one per line, within ±1,000,000 mm.
protectedRouteLayers: Show and unlock this route layer and its assigned circuit layer to edit the route.
createFloorDeviceScope: Create a native device and its floor placement together. The linked schematic symbol is placed on the selected drawing page. Generic symbols do not provide manufacturer ratings.
assignmentDiagramNote: Branches show circuit assignments, not conductor wiring or verified protection.
earthingDocumentationNote: Only native PE terminals and their actual drawn wires are listed. Continuity and installation compliance are not certified.
reportNativeScope: Reports use native project data. Blank values remain unspecified. SVG preserves millimetres; PDF uses your browser print settings. PNG is a raster preview capped at 4096 pixels.
reportExportError: Export failed. Allow the print window or retry the download.
plcMappingNote: Terminal and signal assignments are documentation. They never create wires or execute PLC code.
plcScope: Generic native interfaces and explicit I/O documentation. Address syntax must be checked against the chosen PLC. Drawn emergency-stop or interlock circuits are not certified safety functions.
floorSpecialEquipmentScope: Emergency lighting exposes an external battery interface. Fire loop and data contacts stay independent; only the PE point is internally bonded. No ratings, protocol, illumination performance or compliance are inferred.
planRiserScope: A riser shares one X/Y shaft position across two floors. Vertical length uses explicit floor elevations and endpoint heights; it excludes slack, horizontal routes and cable quantities. It creates no electrical connections.
riserNeedsFloors: Add two floors and editable electrical layers to define a riser.
panelScope: Generic boxes use documented component dimensions or explicitly user-supplied dimensions. They are not authentic manufacturer CAD.
panelCoordinates: Millimetres: X right, Y down, Z from back to front. Position is the minimum corner; rotation swaps width and height.
panelOrbit: Drag the 3D view to orbit; both views share the same native geometry.
panelDragHint: Select an object in either view. Drag in the front view or use the move controls. Each completed move is one undo step.
panelMountingPosition: Check mounting contact and support span
panelCheckScope: Checks use solid boxes and entered clearances. Mounting checks are geometric only; rail-profile compatibility, service access, door travel and electrical/thermal compliance require documented rules and review.
panelExportNote: Generic cuboid layout; dimensions in mm; verify before construction.
panelInvalid: Panel change could not be saved. Check values, references and assigned component dimensions.
panelDuctScope: Area estimate = sum of π × outside diameter² / 4 divided by entered usable area. Cable packing, bends, separation and installation rules are not inferred.
panelThermalScope: Steady-state estimate: rise = max(0, total loss − cooling) / (U × exposed area). Every equipment loss must be entered; zero is valid. No hot spots, airflow, transient behavior or certified temperature limits are modeled. Professional review is required before construction.
calcScope: Choose a method and enter the source data. Results are estimates or limited checks of the supplied conditions.
calcEvidenceHint: Document the manufacturer, document edition, table/page and applicable conditions; one note per line. These notes are not independently verified.
calcUnitConversionHint: Changing a unit converts the entered value. Supply every input; engineering factors have no hidden defaults.
calcSaved: Calculation saved in the native project.
calcWarningEstimate: This result is not a verified engineering design. A qualified professional must review construction and protection decisions.
calcWarningEvidence: Input sources and installation conditions are user declarations; the application has not independently verified them.
calcWarningCheckFailed: At least one supplied condition is not met. Review the inputs and proposed equipment.
calcWarningLargeDrop: Calculated drop reaches or exceeds the supply voltage; the steady-state approximation is unsuitable for this input set.
calcErrorUnit: Choose a supported unit for this quantity.
calcErrorRange: Value is outside the method’s allowed range or choices.
calcErrorNumeric: The calculation exceeds numerical limits or has invalid arithmetic.
calcErrorEvidence: Add source and condition notes (8–900 characters per note; at most 50 notes).
calcErrorDcPowerFactor: For DC, enter a power factor of 1 (100%).
calcErrorPowerTriangle: Active power cannot exceed apparent power.
calcErrorTemperature: The supplied temperature correction gives zero or negative resistance.
calcErrorMethod: The saved method version is unsupported. Preserve the record and recalculate using a current method.
calcErrorRecord: Calculation record is incomplete or incompatible with this method.
calcErrorSave: Could not update the native project.
calcFieldResistancePerLength: AC resistance per length at operating temperature
calcFieldReactancePerLength: Reactance per length at operating frequency
calcFieldFixturePower: Complete fixture input power, including driver
calcCheckSelectivity: Fault current below supplied selectivity limit
calcCheckBreakingCapacity: Fault current within supplied breaking capacity
calcCheckAmpacityProtection: Device rated current ≤ corrected cable ampacity
calcAssumptionOhmic: Linear, constant-resistance DC load; voltage and current are magnitudes.
calcAssumptionAcDc: DC requires power factor 1. AC uses RMS voltage/current and true power factor; single-phase only.
calcAssumptionSinusoidal: Power-triangle and phase-angle relations assume sinusoidal steady state; cosφ excludes distortion effects.
calcAssumptionBalanced: Three-phase methods require balanced loads and line-to-line RMS voltage; single-phase methods use phase-to-neutral voltage.
calcAssumptionReactiveMagnitude: The result is |Q|. Leading or lagging direction cannot be inferred from P and S alone.
calcAssumptionTruePowerFactor: λ = P/S is true power factor. It equals cosφ only for sinusoidal voltage/current.
calcAssumptionOneWayLength: Length is the one-way route; the formula includes the return path for single-phase circuits.
calcAssumptionLagging: Voltage-drop approximation supports lagging loads with nonnegative r and x. Use verified operating-temperature/frequency values.
calcAssumptionUserData: All installation, equipment and correction data must be supplied with applicable source and condition notes.
calcAssumptionLinearTemperature: Linear temperature correction is valid only within the stated material range. Supply α and ΔT relative to the resistivity reference temperature.
calcAssumptionOneConductor: Resistance is for one uniform conductor; AC skin/proximity effects and joints are excluded.
calcAssumptionElectricalInput: P is electrical input power; motor shaft power requires the motor calculator and an explicit efficiency.
calcAssumptionLoadingLimit: The permitted loading fraction is supplied by the user; no automatic 80% rule or trip-curve assessment is applied.
calcAssumptionTransformer: Steady-load rating estimate only. Harmonics, temperature rise, impedance, losses, inrush and standard product selection need separate assessment.
calcAssumptionMotorNameplate: Use nameplate operating-point efficiency and power factor. Calculated FLC is an estimate and does not replace manufacturer current data.
calcAssumptionStarting: The starting multiplier is manufacturer/user supplied. Start duration, torque, voltage dip, starter behavior and protection are not simulated.
calcAssumptionConstantPower: Constant active power while on; duty fraction applies over the entered duration.
calcAssumptionCableLoss: Each counted conductor has the entered resistance and RMS current. Include the neutral only with an appropriate separate load model.
calcAssumptionFaultModel: Single-source, balanced three-phase symmetrical RMS fault estimate using explicit total positive-sequence R, X and voltage factor. No IEC 60909 compliance claim, peak/asymmetry, earth faults or omitted source contributions.
calcAssumptionManufacturerPair: The selectivity limit must match the exact upstream/downstream device pair, settings, voltage and manufacturer table edition. Equality at the limit is not accepted.
calcAssumptionCoordinationScope: This is a numerical threshold comparison only. Full overload, short-circuit and earth-fault selectivity, backup protection, trip times and alternative supplies remain unverified.
calcAssumptionCableCandidate: Enter the candidate cross-section and matching tabulated ampacity for its material, insulation, installation method and loaded conductors. The app does not invent a cable table or choose a standard size.
calcAssumptionCableScope: Only I_b ≤ I_n ≤ I_z is checked. Conventional trip current, voltage drop, thermal fault withstand, neutral harmonics, mechanical constraints and disconnection time require separate verification.
calcAssumptionDemand: Apply explicit utilization and coincidence factors to one defined connected-load group. Coincidence is 0–1; it is not the reciprocal diversity factor. No jurisdictional factors are assumed.
calcAssumptionBattery: Constant nominal voltage and load, with explicit usable capacity and efficiency. Temperature, ageing, Peukert/rate effects, inverter standby load, BMS cutoffs and discharge curves require manufacturer assessment.
calcAssumptionUps: Both W and VA ratings must meet the estimate. Battery capacity supports the entered load and runtime; the sizing multiplier applies to UPS ratings only. Crest factor, inrush and product runtime curves remain unverified.
calcAssumptionGenerator: A steady-load/VA envelope only. Enter the entire coincident starting apparent load, including running loads. Separate kW/kVA ratings, motor transients, voltage/frequency dips and manufacturer sizing are required.
calcAssumptionLighting: Fixture input includes driver/ballast losses. This estimates electrical load and energy, not illuminance, emergency-lighting compliance or inrush.
calcAssumptionEarthRing: Approximate buried ring in intimate contact with homogeneous soil. Soil resistivity must be representative and measured. No rods, grids, layered soil, touch/step voltage or automatic compliance assessment; field testing is required.
accountFailure: The account request could not be completed. Check your details and connection, then try again.
accountLocalScope: Guest projects and each account’s local projects stay separate on this browser. Signing in does not upload or adopt guest work. Cloud saves require an explicit action.
accountCheckEmail: If the request is eligible, check your email to continue.
cloudScope: Local edits save on this browser. Cloud actions affect only this verified account. A cloud save stores the snapshot you explicitly submit.
cloudConflict: The cloud version may differ. Load it or explicitly replace it with your local project.
cloudUnavailable: Cloud request unavailable. Local work is retained; reload cloud status before retrying a save.
cloudDenied: Cloud access was denied. Verify your account and try again.
cloudAccountChanged: Account changed; the old cloud response was discarded.
cloudInvalid: Cloud data could not be validated. Local work is unchanged.
cloudMissing: The cloud project or revision was not found.
cloudReplaceLocal: Replace this account’s local project with the selected cloud snapshot? Local undo history for this project will be cleared. Export local work first if needed.
cloudReplaceRemote: Replace the latest cloud project with your current local snapshot? The server will reject the save if another revision arrives first.
cloudHistoryLoaded: Historical revision opened locally. Restoring it to cloud requires an explicit save and conflict review.
cloudPendingScope: A failed response can follow a successful server save. Review the latest cloud state before retrying. Your local project remains available.
cloudRetryReady: No cloud copy exists. You can explicitly save the local project now.
cloudHistoryScope: History contains immutable saved cloud snapshots. Opening a revision changes only your local workspace.
workspaceSearchScope: Search this account’s local projects and drawing pages.
panelStructureScope: Doors represent their closed solid volume; hinge motion is not modeled. Compartments are non-solid named regions and do not imply physical partitions or electrical segregation.
panelFeaturesScope: Centres and sizes are in millimetres. Back/front use U=X, V=Y; left/right U=Z, V=Y; top/bottom U=X, V=Z. Outlines document machining positions; they do not subtract material from a CAD solid or validate fastening.
accountOffline: Local account workspace; cloud access awaits session verification.
avatarScope: PNG, JPEG or WebP, up to 2 MiB and 4096 pixels per side. Avatars use private account storage and short-lived viewing links.
avatarInvalid: Choose a valid PNG, JPEG or WebP image within the stated size limits.
panelProfileMismatch: Required mounting profile is missing or does not match
panelAccessClearance: Service access clearance (mm; blank = no rule)
panelAccessObstructed: Documented service access zone is obstructed
panelRuleScope: Mounting profiles compare user-entered labels. Access checks use an entered directional clearance prism and closed door volumes. Matching labels do not certify mechanical fit; no access rule means accessibility has not been checked.
reportCalculationUnavailable: Unavailable: unsupported method version or invalid saved calculation.
demoScope: Original educational projects. Generic equipment dimensions are manually defined; no manufacturer or certified design is implied.
noMappedDevice: Select a mapped device in the schematic or cabinet.
localAssistantScope: Deterministic project tools. Hosted AI is not configured.
assistantUnknown: Available commands: check connections, inspect project, bill of materials.
assistantEmpty: Open a project to use these tools.
botNoSelection: No device selected. Select a symbol or cabinet device.
botPreferenceError: Window preferences could not be saved.
botPrivacy: Read-only local tools. Project data stays in this browser.
botNoFindings: No electrical findings from the supported topology rules.
